# Clarify AI

> AI-powered interview preparation platform: live practice coaching during mock and rehearsal sessions, full mock-interview engine with AI-graded scorecards, and a prep lab covering behavioral, technical, and system-design rounds. AI features are for preparation only — not for use during actual third-party interviews.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, comparison, testimonials, FAQ.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro, and Enterprise plan details and credits.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on interview prep, AI coaching, and career strategy.
- [Help](/help): Help center with how-tos, troubleshooting, and FAQs.
- [Shortcuts](/shortcuts): Keyboard shortcuts for the practice overlay and app.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of Service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy Policy and data handling.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a free account (200 credits/month).
- [Log in](/login): Sign in to your Clarify AI account.

## Key features

- Live AI practice coach with sub-second hint latency for mock and rehearsal sessions.
- Multi-model routing across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Gemini 2.0 Flash.
- Mock interview engine with WPM, filler-word, and confidence scoring.
- Resume vs job-description gap analysis.
